title: drawsymbol
description: draw numbers, symbols or texts for data structures

flags.name: -v <symbol>
flags.description: assigns a field to make it visible/invisible

flags.name: -xe
flags.description: disable mouse actions in edit mode

flags.name: -xr
flags.description: disable mouse actions in run mode

flags.name: -x
flags.description: disable mouse actions in both edit and run mode

flags.name: -e
flags.description: select and edit text after a single mouse click

body: [drawsymbol] shows a symbol field of each scalar of the template it is in as text, which you can edit by double-clicking in run mode, or with a single click with -e. The position and color can also be field names, and an optional label is shown in front of the value. The -x, -xe and -xr flags disable mouse actions altogether or in edit or run mode.
